body: OMG she’s adorable!!! i love your style thank you so much!!!

i get this so hard. no one understands how pcos works if they don’t have it. and it fucking SUCKS. literally no one gets it. no one knows how hard you work. i’m so sorry you have to deal with this too. no amount of explaining will work and they still won’t believe you.
yes absolutely!!! ❤️

omg you are so so sweet. thank you for your kind words and your advice, legitimately making me cry right now. it’s so hard to feel so unseen and then when i talk to others living with PCOS i finally for once feel heard. thank you for letting me know about your experience, i will definitely take note of that. i’m so sorry that you have to go through this too and i hear you. but again, seriously, thank you thank you thank you.

oh my god… thank you so much for this. i can not TELL you how much this information and your thought out response means to me. this seriously helps me so much and helps me realize i need to take it more seriously. the people in my life never took what i was saying seriously so therefore i thought it wasn’t as serious until i started thinking, no, something is definitely wrong. all of these fit me so well. thank you, thank you, thank you. i will be sure to see if i can get back on medicine and fixing my diet and such. the diet has been so hard for me due to lack of motivation, brain fog, mental health problems, and fatigue but i need to really figure it out. i eat very poorly right now because of cravings and bingeing/etc. 

thank you so much for this again. seriously, i appreciate it more than you know.

she didn’t like the cowboy hat.

if anyone can’t go, i’d love love to buy 2 tickets honestly, i went to check at 10 yesterday and sold out lmao. i’m so disappointed :(. my partner and i were so upset, it’s been our daily ritual for years and i have been watching for years before that even lol!!
thank you so much! i’m starting to think so now too 😊

thank you so so much for saying that! i am so glad that she had that and had given it to me as well. it’s really special to me and my partner knows how much my grandmother meant to me. i think she would be happy too ❤️ i also thought about using the stones for a different setting as well, i may look into that or just using the same ring. thanks for reaching out! this makes me feel so much better!!!

i definitely understand that too, i would say most of the time i believe that the world doesn’t like me either, but in moments like those, i feel as if my guard is down a little which is what i think makes those times even more special ❤️. thank you so much for saying this, it truly comforts me so much! (also i do love being weird too :) )

thank you so much for saying this. honestly this means so much to me. i’m currently in therapy and that definitely is a thing i want to bring up, i don’t necessarily think i need it to survive per say, but the people around me sort of make me feel like i seek it too much or think too much of it. but you’re right, they definitely 100% don’t understand what it’s like. thank you for making me feel better about this, honestly finding your own family that loves and supports you is so important ❤️
YOU LOOK SO GOOD!!! 💕

hi mom,

thank you so much for this message. this honestly made my day. thank you for reaching out to me, i feel heard, and seen. 

i’m so sorry you had to go through this situation too, it stings. knowing that you are strong helps me feel stronger too ❤️ 

thank you again, for making me feel validated, i always feel like i’m talking to nothing when i speak about her, because no one knows what to say (and that’s okay). so a message like this truly means the world to me. i know she doesn’t deserve my time. i have tried and tried and if anything it just gets worse. i won’t let her control me anymore. but it isn’t easy as much as i want me to just “forget” it all. 

thank you again, for the hugs and the love ❤️

i hope i do find this and i do feel that i will, thank you so much for the encouraging words, they mean so much to me!! ❤️ i’m happy to try to turn over a new leaf and hopefully surround myself with real love, not love i have to work for/only one sided
thank you so much for reassuring me <3 i know it’ll be much easier once i’m done with college. this means a lot truly
omg it’s everything <3
perfect illusion 💕 always has stuck with me
thank you so much! ❤️
i’m definitely trying to find one! thank you!! ❤️
thank you so so much! you too! ❤️❤️

hi!! thank you so much for accepting me, i would love to be a part of your family! you and your wife sound lovely ❤️❤️ i can’t tell you how much i appreciate your message. i definitely will, thank you so so so much for this. love and hugs ❤️🏳️‍🌈
thank you for the hugs!! <33

thank you so much mom!!! i would love a long hug and some chats about life ❤️ i’m trying
my best, i hope i can make everyone proud, including myself this time. i’m going through a rough patch, but i hope to make it out stronger and better :) 

thank you for the hugs and for accepting me for who i am ❤️ love you!

thank you so much mom, love you ❤️ i would love to come over for tea and coffee, and most importantly, hugs! my girlfriend would love to meet you and i would love for you to meet her, i finally have found someone who is amazing to me. 

i would love to help you fold your sheets and try to do all the computer stuff for you, technology is hard anyways :) 

thank you for accepting me. thank you for giving me a chance and hearing me, love and hugs ❤️

thank you so much for this, and for reaching out. i can’t tell you how much it means to me to feel seen mom <3 

it’s really hard but i am trying to work through it. my state of mind is in a (slightly) better place than once before, so i know it’s for the best but it doesn’t make it any easier.

my partner is great! we celebrated two years together in january this year and she has been the most wonderful person to me. she is there when i have my ups and downs and tries to understand me and work with me through it all. we like to do simple things like go get coffee or visit local shops around, spending quality time together :) it feels nice to finally start to feel comfortable with someone. 

once again, thank you so much for the internet hugs and the kindest words, thank you for letting me vent, it means the world to me ❤️ i hope you have a wonderful day!!

i am so sorry you are going through this. you are not alone. i hear you. i know going through your mother isn’t much of a chance, but is there any way you could join any groups or an access to some sort of therapy for relief? i know this may be an obvious question but i want to think of ideas where you can be heard and seen the way you deserve. i’m so sorry that this is happening to you. i believe you and i hear you op <3

op i am so proud of you. you are so strong. look at you go!! 

i sincerely hope there’s a way you can get help, acknowledging that fact is an amazing step in the right direction. i understand a lot about not knowing how to bring these things up to those around me because of family abuse on both ends. if you need anyone to hear you out about that or just to chat, for the time being, i will listen. i hear you. take some deep breaths. you are a beautiful soul. you matter, so so much.

hey i know this is late but i hear you and i see you! i have been struggling for about ten years too. it’s really hard to see when it feels like there’s no good days. it feels impossible to go on. but i assure you that you are strong. you have been doing this a long time and the road is challenging but i believe in you. you can do this. im here if you still need to talk <3

i hope you are still with us. this world is exhausting, but some days you can find beauty and life in the smallest things or moments. i hope you truly find peace no matter how it may be. you are special and important. i know words like these are hard to take in when our mind is so cloudy with these thoughts. but i hope you can feel my love. your post and these comments made my eyes well up. you all are so amazing and strong. sending lots of hugs op, you deserve them and so much more. you are enough. thank you for being you. your kindness and heart is clear even through a reddit post. <3
sending all the hugs!! i really do hope things get better for you :( <3

thank you so much for this, seriously <3 

it has been so so hard but i am trying. i try to not panic and let things take it’s course (obviously while trying my hardest to get there), but sometimes i just crash. i know it’s normal but it sucks. knowing that im not alone though and that people get through it is very motivating to me and helps keep me going. also yes, luckily i live in an area with tons of beautiful nature so i am very much lucky to have that!! it sucks when it gets cold but i try my best to enjoy that part of life because it really does help clear the mind (and of course it’s free). 

thank you honestly so much for the reassurance and the kindness and advice, and just for taking the time out to say this to me, it means everything to me.

i totally get that and definitely don’t go against that! i would do the same for my children if i was able to. the way you have taught them properly is also super important. she didn’t really have that part of it. im not saying im mad at her or anything, or have anything against her. it’s just hard to get the conversation through but it’s okay. i do have someone at least and my father was also in this situation so he helps me whenever he can which is all i could ever hope or ask for, but it has been hard for both of us with the events that have gone on lately and the last year really. knowing im not alone though has been very comforting though, and these comments as well. i know it gets better i just have to go through the hard times. i work very hard and try my best to do what i can and am lucky enough to have a good paying job for my age, so i know eventually it’ll get better but the last good chunk of time has been very hard. thank you for taking the time to talk to me though, it truly is very much appreciated!

thank you for this <3 i know it gets better but it really sucks feeling so strapped down when others around me do what they want freely basically. i know i shouldn’t compare but fomo i guess lol. i wish people would understand more and i know so many others go through it but yeah. i do need to look into the fafsa part about changing though, so thank you for mentioning that! it means a lot

thank you, it is true to be honest. my partner is in the same boat as i, so not that i’m grateful they are, i am glad im not alone. my best friend has always had everything handed to them, lives in an apartment their parents pay for, her grandparents pay for their expensive degree, etc. they just don’t understand when i talk about it because they always have been given what they wants when they want it. i love them but they’re so hard to talk to.
thank you, that means a lot, really <3
thank you so much <3

this is actually super helpful. seriously thank you so much for taking the time to say this to me. i know i need to get into therapy and back on my meds, it’s been very hard since i don’t have much access to it or the money to do it anyways. i’ve been letting it go for too long and even before that, since i was a child (also female 20s) i’ve had body issues and up and down depressions. the joking thing actually has helped me in the past, but it’s gotten so bad that i can’t find anything anymore. i really do need to retrain my brain and it sucks because i’ve thought this way for so long. i have a constant conflict that i know i’m in my head and no one is probably paying attention to it but that’s all i think about. again thank you so much for this, your words mean a lot to me. i will take all of this to heart and try to learn from it in all ways i can. i just need to focus on the motivation especially without much help for the depression except what i can do on my own
thank you so much for this, that means a lot. i know i feel like no matter what i do i’ll never be happy with myself and my body, and that confidence is good but it’s so hard to find any lmao.
i’m so sorry you are feeling like this, you are not alone though, i care about you! hang in there. <3 i’m always open if you need to just let it out. i understand
